detections.evidence_quote: My throat was slashed. Got stabbed here. Hit by an axe. Here, screwdrivers punctured my back, my lung, broke three ribs.
detections.summary: Four people died in a 1983 home invasion; the survivor lists his injuries: slashed throat, stab wounds, axe blow, punctured lung and three broken ribs.

detections.evidence_quote: she was still haunted by what happened to her family 17 years earlier
detections.summary: A grandmother remains haunted 17 years after her family's murder; the survivor says losing someone changes your life and hurts.

detections.evidence_quote: also lost his life, all stabbed and slashed to death
detections.summary: Four victims, including two children, were stabbed and slashed to death; an eight-year-old survived.

detections.evidence_quote: according to the coroner, the victims had some 140 wounds
detections.summary: According to the coroner the victims had some 140 wounds from multiple weapons.
The surviving boy, too wounded to speak in hospital, indicated three attackers and lists where he was hurt.
